newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: PORTUGAL'S INPARSA MULLS CAP INCREASE.
newsitem.headline: PORTUGAL'S INPARSA MULLS CAP INCREASE.

text.p: The Sonae group's Inparsa-SGPS has called an extraordinary general assembly for September 12 to consider a capital increase of 19.5 billion escudos to 29.25 billion escudos, according to an announcement due to be published in Portuguese newspapers tomorrow.
According to the announcement, the capital increase would take place via an incorporation from reserves of 4,875,000 shares and a subscription reserved for shareholders of 4,875,000 new shares.
Inparsa shares closed up 44 escudos to 3,849 in volume of 277,855 shares.
